notes.title: Pizza Titan Ultra - New Pricing - PAX 10 Sale - Soundtrack Update!
notes.notes:
Breakfall had an awesome PAX West this year, which featured Pizza Titan Ultra in the PAX 10 - the 10 most fun indie games of the year, selected by a huge panel of industry experts!

To celebrate and bring pizza delivery to a wider audience than ever before, Breakfall is permanently dropping the price of the game!

In a deal of pizza and wings proportions, we’re also launching this new price with a further 15% discount! Yowza, let that slice cool before you try to pick it up, because it’s so hot and fresh it’s too much to handle!

A final note, we are offering the much requested soundtrack to the game, as standalone DLC or in a discounted (third discount!? MADNESS) bundle with the game. Never go another day without hearing the Pizza Titan Ultra theme song, in glorious high quality mp3 format!

notes.title: Pizza Titan Ultra Soundtrack Update
notes.notes:
Hello mech pilots!

A fresh update for Pizza Titan Ultra is now live! 

UPDATES
-Stability and performance fixes
-Updated VFX
-New balancing, reduction of some enemy drops, tweaked spawns in most Challenge missions
-Massive soundtrack update, with unique music for every Chapter and Challenge in the game!

THE SOUNDTRACK
On that last point, we’d like to elaborate a little. We have changed the majority of missions in the game to have new music! You’ll hear a few Challenges that have the same base music, but almost all the Chapters have something new and customized to the personality of that mission - whether that’s the VIP, the enemies present, or just the insane situation at hand.

Along with rebalancing enemy spawns and a few objectives, it’s a pretty big upgrade to the gameplay and soundtrack. We think the personality and pacing of the game is now more varied and interesting than a 10-topping XL from your favourite delivery place.

We also want to let you know that those of you who bought the game early (all current owners) have been upgraded to the Soundtrack Edition. As soon as the game is updated you’ll find a folder called “Mike O.K. - Pizza Titan Ultra Soundtrack” containing all the mp3s.

We’re going to be dropping the price further with a non-soundtrack edition very soon - tell your friends to wishlist us!

To all our fans and early adopters: we’re handing out our soundtrack for free as a special thanks for joining us on this journey of giant robot pizza delivery!
